name: memeloop-monorepo
description: MemeLoop open-source monorepo (protocol, core runtime, prompt-editor, node).

scripts.build: pnpm --filter memeloop run build && pnpm --filter @memeloop/libp2p run build && pnpm --filter memeloop-cli run build && pnpm --filter @memeloop/protocol run build && pnpm --filter @memeloop/react-ui run build
scripts.build:with-latest-catalog: pnpm --filter memeloop catalog:sync && pnpm run build
scripts.test: pnpm check:network-contract && pnpm check:bounded-conversation-reads && pnpm test:acceptance-tools-unit && pnpm -r run test
scripts.test:ci: pnpm test && pnpm --filter memeloop-cli run test:e2e
